name: dumbbell goblet 2 sec hold squat
description: A goblet squat with a two-second pause in the bottom. The pause builds leg strength and control out of the hole.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Squat down with your chest tall until your thighs are at least parallel.
Hold the bottom position for two seconds.
Drive through your heels to stand.
